entries.question: Can I install UniOS alongside Windows?
entries.answer: Yes, the installer supports dual boot.

entries.question: How do I update the system?
entries.answer: Run `sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade` in a terminal.

entries.question: Something is broken. Where do I report it?
entries.answer: Open an issue on our GitHub repository or reach out on Discord.

entries.question: Can I use UniOS on my personal laptop?
entries.answer: Absolutely - it is designed for any hardware.

entries.question: Is UniOS free?
entries.answer: Yes, UniOS is free as in freedom not as in beer.
